title: Ryder's Cove Gem | KEY.co
description_expanded: Space and luxury echo throughout this haven. The first-floor master suite is the epitome of comfort, boasting a king-sized bed and an en suite office space. Mornings here are magical: imagine waking up to a panorama of the water, brewing your favorite coffee, and plotting the day's adventures from a deckside rocking chair. Upstairs, two additional bedrooms promise restful slumbers, with one offering an unparalleled aquatic outlook. For those seeking more leisurely indoor pursuits, the "kids' den" and lower-level entertainment spaces provide ample opportunities for relaxation and play. Tucked away on a peaceful cul-de-sac, this home melds modern conveniences with nature's splendors. Stay connected with high-speed Wi-Fi or unplug and embrace the outdoors with the provided kayak and stand-up paddleboard. The residence, fully air-conditioned and laden with amenities, ensures an idyllic retreat for both relaxation and recreation. From the twinkly porch lights to the outdoor gas fire pit, every detail has been thoughtfully curated to offer guests an unforgettable waterfront sojourn.
